_about: Where each division hero photo is cropped. desktop = the wide hero (the glass card sits on the left, the subject stays on the right), mobile = the 4:3 band on a portrait phone. scrim = the directional gradient on the LEFT of the hero (black over a dark tone, white over a light tone), measured against the real photos in design/hero-contrast.test.ts. glass = the card fill. Change a number here and in design/index.css together; the test fails if they differ.
